notes: Search summaries blended pages, so URL attribution within nhs.uk/medicines/atorvastatin/ pages is by topic (hub, how-and-when, side-effects, who-can) and not certain for the 12-month liver tests (cited to the hub page). Ledger sentences claiming lifelong use, prescription-only status, NHS 111 for side effects, fibromyalgia, and 'MedlinePlus says no statins in pregnancy' were not found and were cut; the NHS 111 Wales page supplied the stricter pregnancy/breastfeeding wording. BHF statins page said grapefruit/simvastatin. Two sentences counted as textbook (2 of 70). Existing medications.json entry was not inspected for contradictions (file is keyed differently); a human should check it does not say lifelong use or prescription-only unsupported. First-pass 'the NHS says to skip the missed dose' was wrong (NHS: take when remembered unless it is already the next day) and was cut as a dosing schedule. NHS 111 Wales host is not nhs.uk; compiler may give a build note.
